_DESIGN_RULE: budget is a WALLET, shared across all three lines, and it is visible. Every sale draws it down. Offers are never blocked - a sale bigger than what is left goes through anyway, you got them to stretch - but once the wallet hits zero the sale is over. Catalogue is $11,400 at list, so nobody can have everything. Products cost the same for everyone.
